name: MemMachine
tagline: Open-source memory layer for AI agents.
description: MemMachine is an open-source memory layer that lets AI agents learn, store and recall information across sessions, turning stateless chatbots into personalized, context-aware assistants. It combines episodic memory (conversational context) with profile memory (long-term user facts) and is model-agnostic, working across providers. It is self-hosted and built primarily in Python.
insight: Initially incubated by enterprise-memory vendor MemVerge before spinning out as a community-driven project (~3k+ GitHub stars).

modelSupport.notes: Memory infrastructure that works across multiple AI models and providers simultaneously.

edge: Pairs episodic (conversational) and profile (long-term user-fact) memory in one model-agnostic, self-hostable layer.
cons: Managed enterprise tier not yet GA

references.title: Top 10 AI Memory Products 2026: The Emerging Memory Layer for Agents
